> Search Results for `Cabbage Black Rot Management` **Krushi VNMAU** ``` - **Bacterial Leaf Blight [जीवाणुजन्य कडाकरपा रोग]:** Blight [करपा]-like symptoms [लक्षणे] appear on both edges of the rice [बासमती तांदूळ] leaves. It is called 'BLB'. Diseased leaves reduce crop yield [पीक उत्पादन]. - **Leaf Spot [पानांवरील ठिपके]:** This symptom [लक्षण] is very common in diseases caused by microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. Initially, yellowish, small, oily spots appear on the leaves. Over time, they enlarge and spread throughout the leaf. This reduces crop yield [पीक उत्पादन]. In the 'Black Rot [काळा कुज]' disease [रोग] of cabbage [पत्ता कोबी], 'V'-shaped spots appear on the edges of the leaves. As the disease [रोग] progresses, these microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] enter the stem and eventually grow in the cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] heads. The diseased heads rot and emit a foul odor. Hence, this disease [रोग] is called 'Black Rot [काळा कुज]' of cabbage [पत्ता कोबी]. - **Black Arm:** In cotton [कापूस], the branches turn black due to these microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. Spots appear on the leaves, and oily spots also appear on the bolls. The cotton [कापूस] inside is damaged. The yield [उत्पादन] is significantly reduced. - **Ring Rot:** This is a symptom [लक्षण] of a disease [रोग] caused by microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] in potatoes. When a diseased potato [बटाटा] is cut, a yellow ring is visible. When the potato [बटाटा] is squeezed, a yellowish substance oozes out of the ring. It appears shiny and pearl-like. It contains numerous microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. This disease [रोग] spreads from infected seeds as well as from diseased potatoes remaining in the soil [माती]. These microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] thrive in warm, humid weather [वातावरण]. They reside in the soil [माती]. When a new crop [पीक] is planted, they attack it. The emergence [उगवण] of ring rot potatoes causes losses. The eyes [डोळे] of diseased seeds are black and sunken. It is usually difficult to identify these seeds from the outside. The ring is visible only when it is cut. - **Citrus Canker [लिंबुवर्गीय खैरा रोग]:** Rough spots appear on kagzi lime [चुना] (citron). Numerous such spots also appear on the leaves. This symptom [लक्षण] is caused by a disease [रोग] caused by a microorganism called _Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. citri_. This disease [रोग] deteriorates the quality of lemons. - **Oily Spot Disease [रोग]:** Oily spot disease [रोग] of pomegranate [डाळिंब] is a bacterial disease [बॅक्टेरियाजन्य रोग] caused by _Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. punicae_. These bacteria [जीवाणू] can survive in a dormant state for about 6 to 8 months in diseased leaves, fruits, and fallen debris and multiply rapidly in favorable conditions. This disease [रोग] causes immense damage to the pomegranate [डाळिंब] crop [पीक]. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` 5. **Sheath Blight [शेंडे करपा]:** The symptoms [लक्षणे] of the disease [रोग] are found on the lower leaves near the water level at the time of tillering [बाजूच्या फांद्या वाढणे]. There are elongated or elliptical greenish ash colored spots of 1 cm length with irregular dark red margins and ash color in the center. Similar symptoms [लक्षणे] are also found on the stems of the crops. Diseased plants do not fill with good grains [धान्ये] and show damaged and broken grains [धान्ये]. The severity of this disease [रोग] is higher in the Kharif season [खरीप हंगाम]. Cloudy weather [वातावरण], humid air, and temperature [तापमान] are conducive for the growth [वाढ] of this disease [रोग]. For the management [व्यवस्थापन] of this disease [रोग], Valydamycin 3% L. 25 ml or Propiconazole 25% EC 10 ml or Hexaconazole 5% EC 20 ml or Carbendazim 50% D. P. 10 grams should be mixed in 10 liters of water and sprayed. 6. **Sheath Rot:** This is a fungal disease [बुरशीजन्य रोग] and appears on the upper part of the leaves of the stem while the earheads are emerging. The spots of this disease [रोग] are red and irregular, with ashy and red margins. Diseased plants have less grains [धान्ये] filling and production [उत्पादन] may be reduced. For the management [व्यवस्थापन] of this disease [रोग] 1) Plant seedlings at proper spacing [अंतर]. 2) Burn the diseased stubble [खुंट] 3) Use nitrogen fertilizer [नायट्रोजन खत] in a balanced way. ``` ---- **Krishi Darshani Dr BSKKV, Dapoli 2025** ``` Inter-cultural operations: Weeding [तण काढणे] should be done approximately 20 to 25 days after planting. Earthing up [भर देणे] should be done during weeding [तण काढणे]. Remove the lower 1 to 2 leaves during the growth [वाढ] period after transplanting [पुनर्लागवड]. Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]: Cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] crops are infested by pest [कीड] such as aphids [मापकीड], green caterpillars, cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] root fly, and red spider mites [अळ्या], and by diseases such as leaf spot [पानांवरील ठिपके], black rot [काळा कुज], and clump rot. At the formation of heads, Spray the 1 ml of 50% malathion + 2.5 grams of copper [तांबे] oxychloride or 2.5 grams of zineb per litre of water. These sprays should be done two to three times at intervals of 10 to 12 days. Harvesting [कापणी] and Yield [उत्पादन]: Cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] should be harvested when the head is fully formed and firm. Cabbage [पत्ता कोबी] yields 20 to 25 tons per hectare. Special Care: Select the right variety considering the duration of cold weather [वातावरण]. Supply the right amount of fertilizers accordingly. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` **Gonosephalum Beetle:** After germination [अंकुरण] of chickpea [हरभरा] seeds, seedlings appear to be cut off near the ground and fallen over. The main reason for this infestation is the beetle of the Gonosephalum species [प्रजाती]. Farmers also know this pest [कीड] as black buffalo [म्हैस]. The beetle in the adult stage is 10 mm long and 5 mm wide. The color of the beetle is blackish, grayish, or soil [माती]-colored. The female Gonosephalum lays eggs [अंडी] in the soil [माती], and the larval stage also remains in the soil [माती]. The adult beetles live in the soil [माती] and eat the sprouts of the seeds, causing chickpea [हरभरा] seedlings to be found fallen in the field [शेत]. Adults live in crevices in the upper layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of the soil [माती], and these beetles are not easily visible during the day. **Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** Use fully decomposed organic manure [सेंद्रिय खत] to avoid Gonosephalum beetle infestation. Plow the soil [माती] deeply. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] early (until the last week of October). ### **Chickpea [हरभरा] Crop Diseases [पीक रोग]:** **1) Wilt [मररोग]:** This disease [रोग] is caused by the fungus Fusarium oxysporum (ciceris). As soon as the infestation occurs, the leaves turn yellow and wilt [मररोग]. The shoots become drooped, and the plant dries up in the green state. question: थीट पेरणी झालेल्या भातात बियूशानिंग कसे करावे?
answer:
थीट पेरणी झालेल्या भातात तण नियंत्रणासाठी खालीलप्रमाणे तणनाशक फवारणी करावी:

- **पेंडिमेथालिन ३०% ईसी** (स्टॉम्प) : पेरणीनंतर साधारण ५ दिवसांनी, १.० ते १.५ लिटर प्रति एकर या प्रमाणात ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करावी; ही फवारणी थेट पेरणी भातातही करता येते.
- **ऑक्सिफ्लोरफेन २३.५% ईसी** (गोल्ड) : पेरणीनंतर ५ दिवसांच्या आत, ६५० मि.ली. ते १.० कि.ग्रॅ. प्रति एकर या प्रमाणात ५०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करावी.
- **बिस्पिरिबॅक सोडियम १०% ईसी** (अडोरा/नॉमिनी गोल्ड) : थेट पेरणी भातात पेरणीनंतर १५ ते २५ दिवसांनी, १०० मि.ली. प्रति एकर या प्रमाणात ३०० लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करावी; ही उगवणीनंतरची निवडक फवारणी असल्याने विविध प्रकारच्या तणांचे नियंत्रण होते.

If an infestation of fall armyworm [लष्करी अळी] is found on this grass, spray 5% neem oil [कडुलिंबाचे तेल] extract or azadirachtin 1500 ppm at 50 ml/10 liters of water. **Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण] Methods**

**1\. Preventive Measures:**

**Preventive measures include methods used to prevent the occurrence and growth [वाढ] of weeds [तण]. e.g., Using certified seeds, sowing [पेरणी] weed-free seeds, eradicating weeds [तण] before sowing [पेरणी] the crop [पीक]. Using fully decomposed farmyard manure [शेणखत]/compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत], preparing the land properly, keeping the farm bunds, water channels/paths, and farm roads weed-free, etc.**

**2\. Curative Measures:**

**All the methods used to reduce the intensity of weeds [तण] after their occurrence fall under this category. e.g.,**

- **Physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and Mechanical Methods: Including hand weeding [निंदन], hoeing [डवरणे], weeding [तण काढणे], digging, tillage [जमिनीची मशागत], cutting, pruning [फांद्या छाटणी], water accumulation in the weed area, burning, mulching [आच्छादन], etc.**
- **Competitive Fast-Growing Crops: Following appropriate cropping patterns, sowing [पेरणी] methods, keeping the number of plants per hectare appropriate, appropriate crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], following intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods, using improved methods of fertilizer [खत] and water application, etc. (non-expensive methods) are included under tillage methods [मशागत पद्धती].**
- **Biological Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण]: Managing the weeds [तण] with the help of various biological components.**
- **Chemical Weed Control [तण नियंत्रण]: Managing the weeds [तण] by using chemical herbicides [तणनाशके].**

**The visible expected effects of using various methods of weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन] and the possibility of adopting a particular type of method depend on the following factors:**

**a. Type of weeds [तण] and the area covered by them.  
b. Climatic conditions.  
c. Economic and social conditions of the region.  
d. Various methods of weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन], economic aspects, and efficiency of the method to be used.**

**Considering many such factors, instead of using a single method for proper weed management [तण व्यवस्थापन], a proper combination of several methods has to be used. This is called the 'Integrated Weed Management [एकात्मिक तण व्यवस्थापन]' method.**

As an alternative to the transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] method, we can plant rice [बासमती तांदूळ] by directly sowing [पेरणी] seeds (Direct Seeded Rice [भाताची थेट पेरणी]) without transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] seedlings. Therefore, to effectively control weeds [तण], rice [बासमती तांदूळ] crops can be cultivated on plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन], and after harvesting [कापणी] the rice [बासमती तांदूळ] crop [पीक], a second crop [पीक] can be taken in the *Rabi* season and a third crop [पीक] can be taken in the summer season [उन्हाळी हंगाम] on the same plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन], thereby increasing production [उत्पादन]. If the plastic mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन] is in good condition in the second year, three more crops can be taken again. Advantages [फायदे] of Cultivation under Plastic Mulch [प्लास्टिक आच्छादन]

- \* Timely planting is possible.
- \* Labor and time are saved.
- \* Crop [पीक] grows vigorously.
- \* The ripening period of the crop [पीक] is reduced.
- \* Production [उत्पादन] increases.

question: सगण आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन कसे करावे?
answer:
सगण आंबा हा एक स्थानिक प्रकार असल्याने विशिष्ट सगण आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन याबद्दलची माहिती उपलब्ध नाही. त्याऐवजी मी आपल्याला उपलब्ध कृषी स्रोतांमधून आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन दाखवतो.

**आंबा बागेचे व्यवस्थापन (स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; नैसर्गिक शेती प्रशिक्षण टूलकिट आणि सर्वोत्तम पद्धती मार्गदर्शिका)**

**फांद्या छाटणी व पर्णछाया व्यवस्थापन:**
- कापणी झाल्यानंतर पहिली छाटणी जून/जुलैपर्यंत पूर्ण करा. खालच्या लटकणाऱ्या फांद्या काढा, आतील गुंडाळलेल्या फांद्या काढून अंगरखा उघडा म्हणजे सूर्यप्रकाश आत जावा, रोगट किंवा मृत फांद्या काढा, आणि एका वेळी एकूण झाडाच्या वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थापेक्षा २५% पेक्षा जास्त काढू नका, अन्यथा फुलोरा कमी होऊ शकतो.
- दुसरी छाटणी फुलोऱ्यापूर्वी डिसेंबरमध्ये करून १२ आठवड्यांत पूर्ण करा. पुन्हा खालच्या लटकणाऱ्या फांद्या काढा, नवीन कोंब परिपक्व लाकडी भागापर्यंत घेऊन तोंडावर छाटणी करा म्हणजे फुलोऱ्याला चालना मिळेल, आणि रोगट/मृत फांद्या काढा.
- जुन्या/उंच वाढलेल्या बागांसाठी पुनरुज्जीवन करता येते: मुख्य फांदी छाटून अंगरखा उघडा, मोठ्या झाडांची एक-तृतीयांश फांद्या छाटा, आणि उगवलेले कोंब नीट संभाळा; झाडांना पाणी, पोषक तत्वे, वाढ नियंत्रक योग्य वापरा आणि फळ गळणे व्यवस्थापन करा.

**अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन:**
- सेंद्रिय पद्धतीत गहनजीवामृत १०–२० किलो प्रति झाड जून/जुलै आणि ऑक्टोबर/नोव्हेंबरमध्ये झाडाच्या वयानुसार द्या.
- जीवामृत फवारणी: १५ वर्षांच्या बागेसाठी १५ लिटर जीवामृत + २०० लिटर पाणी (डिसेंबर/जानेवारी) आणि ३० लिटर जीवामृत + २०० लिटर पाणी (फेब्रुवारी/मार्च) अशी दोन फवारण्या करा.

**फुलोऱ्याचे संरक्षण व कीड व्यवस्थापन:**
- फुलकिडे प्रादुर्भाव आढळल्यास २.५ मिली स्पिनोसॅड ४५% ईसी प्रति १० लिटर पाणी फवारा; प्रादुर्भाव मोठा असेल तर थायमेथॉक्सॅम २५% डब्ल्यूजी २ ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाणी दुसरी फवारणी करा.
- फवारणी करताना फुले फुटत असतील व फळधारणा झाली नसेल तर फळधारणेपर्यंत फवारणी टाळा; जर मोठा प्रादुर्भाव असेल व फवारणी आवश्यक असेल तर परागीकरणासाठी सकाळी १० ते १२ या वेळेचा कालावधी वगळा.
- बागेत गडद निळ्या रंगाचे चिकट सापळे लावा.

**फळमाशी नियंत्रण:**
- फळे सुमारे ६०–६५% पिकण्याच्या आधी फळमाशी सापळे लावा. मेथिल युजेनॉल हे खाद्य बेट ६–७ आठवडे कार्यक्षम राहते; त्यानंतर सापळ्यातील रुंदीत दोन–तीन मिली बेट पुन्हा भरा.

**पाणी व्यवस्थापन व इतर:**
- पावसाळ्यात आंब्याला पाणी जास्त लागत नाही, पण दोन पावसांमध्ये मोठा अंतर असेल तर पाणी द्या.
- कापणीनंतर झाड कमजोर होते; वाळलेल्या/भुक्या/मुरडलेल्या फांद्या छाटून काढा, झाडांचा आकार छाटणीने मर्यादित ठेवा, आणि दुष्काळी परिस्थितीत १% पोटॅश फवारणी झाडांना टिकण्यास मदत करते.

**इंटरक्रॉपिंग (बागेत आंतरपीक):**
- नवीन बाग उभारताना पावसाळ्यापूर्वी कोरडे पेरणी करून उच्च उत्पादन देणाऱ्या जातींचे कलमे लावा.
- ५ वर्षांपर्यंतच्या बागांमध्ये तांदूळ धान्य, डाळी, भाजीपाला, पानेभाजी, भोपळा, दुधी भोपळा अशी आंतरपीके घ्या; दोन ओळींमध्ये पपई, शेवगा, अंजीर अशी भरपूर फळपीके लावा.
- ५ वर्षांहून जुन्या बागांमध्ये सावलीच्या भागात हळद, आले, गाजर, बीट, कांदा, मुळा अशी कंद/मुळ भाजी घ्या; उन्हाळ्याच्या भागात बहुपीक पद्धती अवलंबा.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; नैसर्गिक शेती प्रशिक्षण टूलकिट आणि सर्वोत्तम पद्धती मार्गदर्शिका**

आपली आंबा बाग किती वर्षांची आहे आणि तुम्ही सेंद्रिय व्यवस्थापन करायचे आहे का की रासायनिक?

answer:

१. **छाटणी वेळ व पद्धत:**  
- हलकी ते मध्यम छाटणी नोव्हेंबर–डिसेंबरमध्ये करा.  
- छाटणीपूर्वी बागेला २०–२५ दिवस पाणी देणे बंद ठेवा.  
- छाटणी झाल्यानंतर डवरणे करून खत आणि पाणी द्या.

२. **पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन:**  
- हिवाळ्यात दर १० दिवसांनी पाणी द्या.  
- उन्हाळ्यात मातीचा ओलावा लक्षात घेऊन दर ५–७ दिवसांनी पाणी द्या.

३. **खत व्यवस्थापन:**  
- शेणखत ५–१० किलो प्रति रोप द्या.  
- रासायनिक खत ६०:१२०:१२० ग्रॅम नत्र:स्फुरद:पालाश प्रति रोप द्या.  
- त्यासोबत झिंक सल्फेट ४ ग्रॅम आणि फेरस सल्फेट २५ ग्रॅम प्रति रोप दोन हप्त्यांत (डिसेंबर व जून) द्या.

ही पद्धत लागू केल्याने झाडांची वाढ आणि फुलोऱ्याची चालना येते; छाटणीच्या वेळेला पाण्याचा ताण दिल्यामुळे नवीन कोंबांची वाढ प्रोत्साहित होते आणि त्यानंतर खत-पाणी दिल्यावर फुलोरा चांगला येतो.

The following points should be followed while managing the crop [पीक]

- Select crop [पीक] systems based on soil [माती] and rainfall.
- Crops like cotton [कापूस], tur, Kharif sorghum [ज्वारी], and soybean [सोयाबीन] should be taken in medium to heavy soils.

- Crops like Sunflower [सुर्यफुल], Tur, Bajra [बाजरी], Soybean [सोयाबीन], Sorghum [ज्वारी] should be taken in medium soils.
- Crops like Bajra [बाजरी], Kulthi, Sesame [तीळ], Niger, Castor [एरंड] should be taken in light [प्रकाश] soils.
- Intercropping [आंतरपीक] systems like hybrid sorghum [ज्वारी] + Tur (4:2), Bajra [बाजरी] + Tur (3:3), Soybean [सोयाबीन] + Tur (4:2), Cotton [कापूस] + Udid / Soybean [सोयाबीन] (1:1) cropping systems should be adopted.
- Contingency crop planning [पीक नियोजन] should be done as needed.
- Select early maturing varieties. Keep the proper amount of seeds and do seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया].
- Maintain the proper number of plants. For this, keep the proper distance between the two rows of crops and between the two plants.
- Carry out integrated nutrient management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] and integrated pest [कीड] and disease control [रोग नियंत्रण].
- Adopt integrated weed control [तण नियंत्रण] and carry out chemical weed control [तण नियंत्रण] and inter-cultivation at the right time.
- Sowing [पेरणी] of rabi crops [रब्बी पिके] should be done on time. Depending on the availability of moisture, proper tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] (zero tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] / minimum tillage [किमान मशागत] / general tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]) should be adopted.

**Contingency Crop Planning [पीक नियोजन]:**

Agricultural production [उत्पादन] in the Marathwada division [विभाग] is mainly based on dryland farming [कोरडवाहू शेती], and the production [उत्पादन] capacity of crops depends on the irregularity of rainfall. Stability in production [उत्पादन] can be achieved if proper cropping systems are planned according to the arrival and departure of rainfall. In contingency situations, the following types of situations may arise.

- Late arrival of rains.
- Early departure of rains.
- Rain arrives / departs on time, but there is a long gap in the rains during the crop [पीक] period
- Continuous rain and heavy rainfall.

question: डाळिंबाची फळे तडकण्याची कारणे काय आहेत?
answer:
डाळिंबाच्या फळांमध्ये तडकण्याची (भेगा येण्याची) मुख्य कारणे पुढीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

- पाणी व्यवस्थापनातील अयोग्यता – फळे वाढत असताना जर पाण्याचा पुरवठा अनियमित किंवा अचानक जास्त दिला, तर फळांच्या सालीवर तणाव निर्माण होतो आणि त्यामुळे भेगा येतात.
- बॅक्टेरियाजन्य रोग – डाळिंबावर जेथे ‘तेलसर ठिपके’ हा जीवाणूजन्य रोग आढळतो, तेथे सुरुवातीला फळावर पाणी भरलेल्या तेलसर ठिपके दिसतात; हे ठिपके वेळोवेळी काळपट होतात व एकत्र येऊन मोठे ठिपके बनतात. या ठिकाणी भेगा उभ्या/आडव्या येतात, ज्यामुळे फळाची गुणवत्ता पूर्णपणे खराब होते.
- पावसाचे थेंब, हवा, सरी/कालवा सिंचनातील पाणी यामुळे हा रोग बागेत इकडून तिकडे पसरतो; तसेच निर्जंतुक न केलेली छाटणी साधने, शेतमजूर आणि काही कीटकही पसरणीस मदत करतात.

याशिवाय, फळधारणेच्या काळात पाण्याचे योग्य नियोजन न केल्यास देखील भेगा येण्याचा धोका वाढतो.

## **High-Density Orange [संत्री] Planting Technology**

**(Indo-Israel Orange [संत्री] Production [उत्पादन] Technology)**

Among the various fruit trees grown in our country, orange [संत्री] is a very important fruit crop [पीक] that provides economic stability to farmers. There are many reasons for the low productivity of oranges in the state. These include improper soil [माती] selection, water drainage issues, scarcity of high-quality genuine grafts, lack of proper management [व्यवस्थापन], inadequate irrigation [सिंचन] facilities, large-scale incidence of pests and diseases, lack of improved technology such as planting on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे], adoption of high-density planting [उच्च घनतेची लागवड] methods, pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] technology, and the use of fertilizers through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. With planned use of technology, productivity will certainly increase.

**Climate [हवामान]:** Orange [संत्री] cultivation can be done in areas located at an altitude of 370-1500 m above sea level. The growth [वाढ] of orange [संत्री] trees is excellent in the temperature [तापमान] range of 10 to 350 degrees Celsius. Hot and humid climate [दमट हवामान] is suitable for good orange [संत्री] production [उत्पादन]. This crop [पीक] is well suited to an annual rainfall of 620 to 1200 mm and humidity [आर्द्रता] of 50 to 53 percent.

**Soil [माती] Selection:** Select medium black soil [काळी मृदा] with a depth of 1 to 1.5 meters, good water drainage, a layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of murrum (weathered rock) mixed with soil [माती] or sandy soil [वालुकामय माती], and soil [माती] with an acid-base index between 5.5 and 7.5. The amount of lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] should not exceed 8-10 percent.

**Selection of Grafts:** When buying improved varieties of orange [संत्री] grafts (Nagpuri Orange [संत्री], Nagpur Seedless), purchase them only from government / agricultural universities or licensed nurseries with a good reputation. Grafts should be of high quality, genuine, healthy, grafted on Jamberi or Rangpur lime [चुना] rootstock [खुंट रोपे], and have plenty of fibrous roots (jarva).

Chemical Control [रासायनिक नियंत्रण]: If amaranthine is to be managed through herbicides [तणनाशके], Pendimethalin 30% EC at 3.3 liter per hectare should be applied with a spray of 600 to 700 liters of water in soybean [सोयाबीन], pigeon pea [तूर], black gram [उडीद], and mung bean crops 2 to 3 days before sowing [पेरणी] the crop [पीक] and while there is moisture in the soil [माती], or the same day the crop [पीक] is sown or at most the next day as a pre-emergence herbicide [उगवणपूर्व तणनाशक]. **Soil [माती] Preparation and Raised Bed [उंच वाफे] Preparation:** Plow and harrow [वखर] the selected soil [माती] for orange [संत्री] planting 3 to 4 times deeply to make the soil [माती] friable. Dig ditches around the orchard to ensure proper drainage of water from the soil [माती]. Prepare raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] in the north-south direction. The width of the raised bed [उंच वाफे] near the ground should be 3 meters, the width of the upper part should be 2 meters, and the height should be 40 to 50 cm. The distance between two raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] (center point to center point) should be 6 meters. Dig pits of 1x1x1 feet (length x width x depth) at a distance of 3 meters on each raised bed [उंच वाफे]. Mix 5-10 kg of farmyard manure [शेणखत] and 1 kg of single super phosphate in each pit.

**Planting Management [व्यवस्थापन]:** Orange [संत्री] grafts should be planted during the rainy season in June-July. Dip the selected grafts in a solution of 2.5% copper [तांबे] oxychloride and 1.5% monocrotophos before planting. Plant on the prepared raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे] in the south-north direction, keeping a distance of 3 meters between two plants. Plant the graft in the middle of the pit. The bud of the graft should face south and be kept at a height of 20-25 cm from the ground. This will prevent the bud from being damaged by strong winds. Take care that the roots of the plant are not broken while removing the graft from the polythene bag/nursery [रोपवाटिका].

(ii) Layering [थर लावणे] Method The guava [पेरू] plants selected for layering [थर लावणे] should have the following characteristics: - Large umbrella-shaped canopy [पर्णछाया], healthy branches, and low height - Higher yield [उत्पादन] and excellent quality fruits - More pulp and fewer seeds - White pulp and delicious in taste [चव] - Greater resistance to pests and diseases To mark the trees with these characteristics, tie a strip of red or other colored cloth. 2. ओलावा स्थिर ठेवा – ठिबक सिंचनात थेंबाजवळील क्षेत्रात २०% आच्छादन (ओव्हरलॅप) ठेवून मातीमध्ये सतत ओलावा राहील याची काळजी घ्या; यामुळे खारट पाण्यातील मीठाची एकाग्रता कमी होते.
3. पिके थेंबाजवळ लावा – ठिबक सिंचनात रोपे/पिके थेंबाच्या बाजूला लावली तर मीठाचा ताण कमी होतो.
4. पाणी जास्त वापरू नका – क्षारयुक्त जमिनीत पाण्याचा अतिवापर टाळा; नेहमी आवश्यकतेनुसारच सिंचन द्या.
5. निचरा सुधारणा – जमिनीला सुमारे १% उतारा द्या, शेतात योग्य अंतरावर चर (निचऱ्याच्या खोदा) करा व भरपूर पाणी देऊन विद्राव्य मीठ चरांद्वारे बाहेर काढा.

**MPKV Krishi Darshani**
```
1. Sulphur [गंधक]

Sulphur [गंधक] is used for improvement of the chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन]. By reaction of water and oxygen from air Sulphur [गंधक] generates Sulphuric acids these sulfuric acid’s make a reactions with lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] and produce Calcium [कॅल्शियम] sulphate (Gypsum [जिप्सम]). Chalk + Sulphur [गंधक] + Acid = Gypsum [जिप्सम] + Water + Carbon di-oxide. With generated gypsum [जिप्सम]’s calcium [कॅल्शियम] creates a relations with soil [माती] sodium then Sodium Sulphate generated. Because Sodium Sulphate is soluble in water, gets leeched out with water and the level of sodium reduces in the soils, so the soil [माती] become more workable and physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] improved and good. In chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन] with soil testing [माती परीक्षण], 1/5th the content of gypsum [जिप्सम] can be mixed with FYM and used as soil amendment [मृदा सुधारणा].

**C. Soil Management [मृदा व्यवस्थापन]**

1. **Land Leveling [जमीन समतलीकरण]:**

Leveling is essential for uneven or steeply sloping land. On unevenly levelled fields, water either doesn't reach the elevated areas or reaches in reduced quantities, while it accumulates in excess in low-lying areas. If there is an excessive slope, water applied through canals or wells runs off in the direction of the slope, and less water is available for irrigation [सिंचन]. In saline soils and soils with a high water table [पाण्याची पातळी], waterlogging [पाणी साचणे] should be avoided. Rainwater should also be directed in channels in the direction of the slope. Therefore, a slope of 0.05 to 0.25% is satisfactory for heavy soils, 0.20 to 0.40% for medium soils, and 0.25 to 0.35% for light [प्रकाश], sandy soils.

1. **Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:**

To reduce the salinity [खारटपणा] of the soil [माती] and to prevent the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] from rising after the reclamation of saline soils [क्षारयुक्त मृदेची पुनर्बांधणी], excessive use of water should be minimized. Lesions

Macroscopic lesions like subcutaneous oedema (fluid accumulation in subcutaneous tissue), ascites, haemorrhages, hydrocephalus (abnormal CSF accumulation inside brain cavities), congested lymph node and necrotic foci in the spleen and liver are seen among stillborn and infected piglets. Other lesions include spinal hypomyelinogenesis, congestion in meninges and hypoplasia of cerebellum.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Virus isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and identification is done for definitive diagnosis [निदान] of JEV infection [संसर्ग]. The virus can be isolated from brain extracts and inoculated into cell culture or suckling mice and identified by neutralization test. Plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) is considered the gold standard test as it shows minimal cross reactivity with other flaviviruses. In cell culture, cell lines such as Vero, BHK-21, C6/36 mosquito cell line, and primary cell cultures of chicken embryo [भ्रूण] may be used for virus isolation [अलग ठेवणे]. Molecular assays like quantitative RT-PCR [पीसीआर] and Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (RFLP) are highly sensitive tests that can be used for JEV diagnosis [निदान]. Alternatively, FAT can be done to detect viral antigen in tissues extracted from stillborn piglets or infected foetuses. Compliment fixation test, IgM capture ELISA and haemagglutination inhibition assay are other tests used for JEV serodiagnosis. These serological tests should be interpreted carefully as maternal antibodies might be present in piglets for up to eight weeks and there are chances of cross-reactivity with other flaviviruses.

Differential diagnosis [निदान]

JE in pigs should be differentiated from other diseases with similar presentation, the most common ones being PRRS, CSF, porcine parvovirus [पार्वोव्हायरस] infection [संसर्ग], pseudorabies, coronavirus infection [संसर्ग] and porcine brucellosis [ब्रुसॅलोसिस]. हरितगृहात आर्द्रता (हवेतील ओलावा) नियंत्रणासाठी खालील पद्धती वापराव्यात:

1. **नैसर्गिक हवेची आदळ ठेवा:**  
   - हरितगृहाच्या बाजूंना किंवा छप्पराला एकूण क्षेत्रफळाच्या २० ते ३०% उघड्या जागा/झिरे ठेवा, जेणेकरून गरम हवा बाहेर जाईल आणि थंड हवा आत येईल.  
   - झिरे उत्तर किंवा पूर्व दिशेने उघडण्याची सोय असेल तर हरितगृहातील तापमान कमी राहते आणि आर्द्रता देखील नियंत्रणात राहते.

2. **फॅन-पॅड किंवा फॉगिंग सुविधा वापरा:**  
   - जर आपल्या हरितगृहात फॅन-पॅड (हवेची आदळ पंखा व सेल्युलोस पॅड) असेल, तर ती चालू ठेवून हवा बदल आणि आर्द्रता कमी करण्याचा उपयोग होतो.  
   - फॉगिंग यंत्रणा असेल तर पीकांच्या गरजेनुसार त्यावरून सूक्ष्म कोरडे धुकेंड काढा; हे हवेतील आर्द्रता वाढवण्यासाठी/कमी करण्यासाठी मदत करते.

3. **सावलीचे जाळे लावा:**  
   - छप्पराला साधारण ५०% पांढऱ्या रंगाचे यूव्ही स्थिर सावलीचे जाळे आणि बाजूंना ३५% सावलीचे जाळे लावा, जेणेकरून अतिउष्णता टाळली जाईल आणि आर्द्रतेवर परिणाम होईल.

4. **आंतरिकातील हवा सतत फिरवत ठेवा:**  
   - दररोज झिरे/झिपा उघडून गरम हवा बाहेर काढा आणि थंड हवा आत यावी याची दक्षता घ्या.  
   - पिकांभोवती हवा फिरत राहिली तर आर्द्रता एकाच ठिकाणी साचत नाही.

5. **प्लास्टिक आवरण हवाबंद ठेवा:**  
   - हरितगृहाच्या प्लास्टिक आवरणातून हवा निसटू नये याची काळजी घ्या; अन्यथा आर्द्रतेचे नियंत्रण कमी होते.

6. **अतिओलावा असल्यास:**  
   - हवेची आदळ जास्त ठेवा, फॅन-पॅड चालू ठेवा आणि फॉगिंग थांबवा.  
   - पावसाळ्यात किंवा सकाळी ओलावा जास्त वाटत असेल तर झिरे पूर्ण उघडा आणि पाण्याचा मधल्या रस्त्यावर स्प्रे करणे थांबवा.

7. **अतिकोरडेपणा असल्यास:**  
   - फॉगिंग किंवा सूक्ष्म कोरडे धुकेंड वापरा आणि हवेची आदळ थोडी कमी करा.  
   - गरज असल्यास मधल्या रस्त्यावर पाण्याचा स्प्रे करून आर्द्रता वाढवता येते.

8. **इतर काळजी:**  
   - हरितगृहाची बाजूंची उंची ३ ते ३.५ मीटर आणि मध्यभागी उंची ५ ते ६ मीटर ठेवली तर हवा चांगली फिरते.  
   - लोखंडी चौकट पांढऱ्या रंगाची बनवली तर आत तापमान वाढत नाही.

answer:
पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये नैसर्गिक हवा खेळती राहण्यासाठी जमिनीवर आच्छादन म्हणून **प्लास्टिक आच्छादन** हेच मुख्य आच्छादन साहित्य मानले आहे, आणि ते पॉलीहाऊस/शेडनेट घरातील भाजीपाला पिकांसाठी अनुदान-पात्रही ठरवले आहे.

प्लास्टिक आच्छादन कधी वापरावे:
- भाजीपाला पिकांच्या (उदा. शिमला मिरची, टोमॅटो, ब्रोकोली, काकडी, चेरी टोमॅटो, पत्ता कोबी, सलाड पत्ता, खरबूज, चिली) लागवडीसाठी पॉलीहाऊस/शेडनेट घरात बेड तयार करून प्लास्टिक आच्छादन ओल्या मातीवर विछायचे असते; त्यामुळे जमिनीत ओल टिकून राहते व तण नियंत्रण होते.
- फुलशेती पिकांसाठी प्लास्टिक आच्छादनाचा उल्लेख उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजात नाही; त्यामुळे तुम्ही फुलपीक लावणार असाल तर स्थानिक कृषी अधिकाऱ्याकडून मार्गदर्शन घ्या.

आच्छादन साहित्य निवडताना काय लक्षात घ्या:
- प्लास्टिक आच्छादन (मल्चिंग) पिकाच्या बेडावर ओल्या मातीवर विछावून बाजूंना दाबून अथवा झाकून ठेवावे, जेणेकरून हवा खेळती राहिली तरी ओल व तापमान नियंत्रित राहील.
- प्लास्टिक आच्छादन किती जाडीचे/रंगाचे वापरावे याबाबत नेमकी तांत्रिक शिफारस (जसे की जाडी, रंग) दिलेली दस्तऐवजात उपलब्ध नाही; त्यामुळे तुमच्या पिकाप्रमाणे योग्य प्रकार निवडण्यासाठी जवळच्या कृषी सेवा केंद्राशी किंवा कृषी अधिकाऱ्याशी बोला.

पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये आच्छादन कसे करावे:
- बेड तयार करून माती ओलसर ठेवून प्लास्टिक आच्छादन विछावे; त्यावर रोपे लावणीचे छिद्रे/विभाग ठेवावेत.
- आच्छादनाच्या बाजूंना मातीने दाबून ठेवाव्यात, जेणेकरून हवेमुळे आच्छादन सरकणार नाही.

तुमच्या पिकासाठी पुढील मदत:
- तुम्ही पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये कोणते पीक लावणार आहात? त्यानुसार योग्य आच्छादन प्रकार निवडण्यासाठी मी अधिक मार्गदर्शन देऊ शकतो.

**स्रोत: एनडीकेएसपी टप्पा २ शेडनेट_पॉलीहाऊस लागवड साहित्य मार्गदर्शक सूचना**

सॅवली-जळी (हरितगृह) ग्रुहात पांढरी माशीचे नियंत्रण करण्यासाठी खालील उपाय करा:

**१. जैविक कीटकनाशकाचा वापर:**  
फुले बागीसाइड (लेकॅनिसिलियम लेकानी) हे जैविक कीटकनाशक हरभरा पिकांवर, फुलझाडांवर आणि हरितगृहातील भाजीपाला पिकांवर पांढरी माशीसह इतर रस शोषणाऱ्या किडींचे प्रभावी नियंत्रण करते. यात सुमारे १० कोटी बुरशीच्या बीजाणू प्रति ग्रॅम असतात. फवारणी करताना पुढील गोष्टी लक्षात ठेवा:
- फवारणी सकाळी/संध्याकाळी कमी वारा असताना करा.
- प्लास्टिक फिल्मवर थेट कीटकनाशक फवारणे टाळा.
- आवश्यकतेनुसार १५ दिवसांच्या अंतराने दुसरी फवारणी घ्या.

**२. हरितगृहातील हवेची आदळ व स्वच्छता:**  
- हरितगृहात एकूण क्षेत्रापैकी साधारणपणे ३०% उघड्या जागेची सोय ठेवा, म्हणजे ताजे हवेचे प्रवेश व गरम हवेचा निचरा होईल; त्यामुळे पांढरी माशीचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.
- सॅवलीच्या जाळीचे कवच (ऊरवर ५०% व बाजूला ३५%) वापरा.
- तण काढून टाका व भिंतींजवळची तणही काढा.

**३. रासायनिक नियंत्रण (अत्यंत गरज असल्यास):**  
- ऊसावर पांढरी माशी दिसल्यास डायमेथोएट ३०% २.६ मि.ली. प्रति लिटर पाण्यात मिसळून फवारणी करा.
- हरितगृहात फवारणी करताना प्लास्टिक फिल्मवर थेट औषध फवारणे टाळा.

question: Mruda sanrakshanasaathi samantar bandh kase bandhavet?
answer:
माती संवर्धनासाठी समानांतर बांध म्हणजेच समपातळी (समोच्च) बांध कसे बांधायचे हे खालीलप्रमाणे सांगितले आहे:

**समपातळी बांध काय आहेत?**
समपातळी बांध पाण्याचा वाहता थांबवून ते मातीमध्ये झिरपते यासाठी बांधले जातात. जमीन उतार असल्यास हा उपचार विशेष फायदेशीर ठरतो आणि उत्पादनात वाढ होते, तसेच माती धुप नियंत्रणात येते.

**कोणत्या परिस्थितीत समपातळी बांध घ्यावेत?**
- जमीन उतार ३% पर्यंत असेल व वर्षातील पाऊस कमी असेल तर समपातळी बांध घेतले जातात.
- पाणी मातीमध्ये झिरपण्याची क्षमता जास्त असल्यास व पाऊस कमी असल्यास, बांधांची उंची ३० सें.मी. ठेवावी आणि दोन बांधांमधील अंतर सुमारे ५ मीटर ठेवावे.
- २–३% उतारावर दोन बांधांमधील अंतर ६०–७० मीटर ठेवणे शिफारसीचे आहे.

**बांध कसा बांधावा?**
1. प्रथम शेतातील समपातळी रेषा निश्चित करा (ए-फ्रेम किंवा लेझर लेव्हलने).
2. त्या समपातळी रेषेवर मातीच्या बांधांचे काम करा; बांधाची उंची साधारण ३० सें.मी. ठेवा.
3. दोन बांधांमधील अंतर आपल्या जमिनीच्या उताराप्रमाणे ठेवा (उदा. ५ मीटर किंवा ६०–७० मीटर).
4. बांध बांधताना पाण्याचा वाहता थांबवून तो वरच्या बाजूकडे झिरपेल अशी व्यवस्था ठेवा.
5. दर ३–४ वर्षांनी खोल नांगरणी करून मातीच्या आतला कडक थर न होईल याची काळजी घ्या.

**जैविक बांधाचा पर्याय:**
- समपातळी रेषेवर सुबाभळ किंवा वाळा गवताचे जैविक बांधही माती धुप कमी करण्यासाठी उपयोगी पडतात.
- सुबाभळचे जैविक बांध उताराप्रमाणे १६–१८ मीटर अंतरावर लावावेत; छाटणीचे हिरवे पाने व फांद्या मातीला दिल्यास नत्राची पातळी वाढते.
- वाळा गवताचा बांध सर्व प्रकारच्या मातीसाठी अधिक कार्यक्षम मानला जातो.

**इतर मदत:**
- नांगरणी, वखरणी व पेरणी ही समपातळीवर करणे, तसेच दोन बांधांमधील मशागत करताना उताराच्या विरुद्ध दिशेने सरी बनवणे यामुळे पाणी जास्त प्रमाणात मातीमध्ये शोषले जाते.

आपल्या शेतात जमीन उतार किती आहे आणि पाऊस सरासरी किती मिळतो, हे सांगाल का? त्यानुसार बांधांची उंची व अंतर योग्य ठरवता येईल.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शनी**

1. **Contour Cropping:** Planting crops always across the slope (preferably at the same level) helps the rainwater to percolate evenly over the entire area. This type of crop [पीक] pattern is called contour cropping. This method must be implemented when the slope of the farmland is more than one percent. Placing guide contour bunds (of khus or other grass) at regular intervals provides direction for sowing [पेरणी] and other tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] operations, and allows more rainwater to seep into the soil [माती].
2. **Soil [माती] Conserving Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत]:** Proper interculture of the crop [पीक] during the growing season keeps the soil [माती] loose and increases the process of rainwater percolation [पाझरण]. If a furrow [सरी] is created between two crop [पीक] rows by tying a rope [दोरी] to the drag of a cultivator [कल्टिव्हेटर (नांगरणीचे अवजार)] during such interculture, it helps to store excess water and seep it into the field [शेत] itself, and the crop [पीक] benefits from it. At the same time, deep plowing [खोल नांगरणी] should be done every 3 to 4 years so that a hard crust is not formed below the surface.
3. **Bund Construction:** In low rainfall areas (up to 600 mm) in light [प्रकाश] and medium soils up to 1 to 6 percent slope, water flowing between two bunds is prevented and seeped into the upper side of the contour bund [समपातळी बांध]. When the annual rainfall is more than 600 mm and the soil [माती] is medium to heavy, diversion bunds should be constructed instead of contour bunds, giving some specific slope (up to 0.2 to 0.6 percent). These bunds control the fast-flowing rainwater and slowly release it out of the field [शेत]. Since this type of bund construction takes time for rainwater to flow out of the field [शेत], it helps to seep some amount of water into the field [शेत] and reduces soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. The distance between the two bunds should be kept 60 to 70 meters for a 2 to 3 percent slope.

## **Soil [माती] and Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]**

**Approximately 82% of the area in Maharashtra is rainfed. Of the rainfall in this area, 30 to 40% of the water percolates into the ground, 20 to 30% evaporates back into the atmosphere, and 30 to 50% flows away as runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी]. This runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] causes soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] of 5 to 20 tons per hectare at various places. It is necessary to carry out soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] works on a large scale with governmental, non-governmental (NGO), and public participation, as well as at the farmers' level, to stop this runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी] and use it for protective irrigation [संरक्षक सिंचन], as well as to control soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप]. Especially, farmers should adopt the following methods of in-situ soil [माती] and water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] on their farms. This will definitely increase production [उत्पादन] through good water conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन] and will control soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप].**

**1\. Contour Bunds:**

**Contour bunds help to stop the flowing water and allow it to percolate into the soil [माती]. These treatments are beneficial in low rainfall areas such as Nandurbar, Dhule, Ahmednagar, Nashik, Solapur, Pune, and some parts of Sangli districts, as well as on land with slopes of up to 3%. If the rate of water infiltration [पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता] into the soil [माती] is high and rainfall is low, contour bunds of 30 cm height should be prepared and the distance between two bunds should be kept at approximately 5 meters. This treatment [उपचार] keeps the moisture level uniform throughout the field [शेत], and production [उत्पादन] increases by 10%, as observed in experiments at Rahuri, Solapur, and Dhule.**

**2\. Graded Bunds:**

4. Care of Laying Hens

After brooding [वाढीसाठी ऊष्मा व काळजी देणे] and rearing, hens start laying eggs [अंडी]. At this time, physically examine the hens and remove those unsuitable for production [उत्पादन]. Only healthy and good quality pullets [८–२० आठवड्यांचे मादी कोंबडे] should be kept in the laying house. The laying period is the most important for production [उत्पादन].

- 1. Litter [कचरा]: Provide adequate space for laying hens, at a rate of 2-2.5 square feet per bird. Keeping too many hens in a small space can lead to wet litter [कचरा] and potential disease [रोग] spread. Also, during summer, there is a possibility of hens dying from heatstroke.
- 2. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] Space: If using trough-type feeders, provide 4-5 inches per bird, or if using a hanging feeder of 16-inch diameter, it is sufficient for 10 hens. Providing less space will lead to hens not eating properly and developing bad habits like feather pecking or injuring each other.
- 3. Drinking Water [पाणी पिणे] Space: It is necessary to provide adequate space for chickens to drink water.
- 4. Nest [अंडी घालण्याचे डबे] Boxes or Laying Nests: Laying nests are necessary in the laying house for egg laying, as hens prefer to lay eggs [अंडी] in a single nest [अंडी घालण्याचे डबे]. This prevents eggs [अंडी] from getting dirty, breaking, and birds from developing the habit of eating eggs [अंडी]. Nest [अंडी घालण्याचे डबे] boxes should be clean, dark, and well-ventilated. Provide one laying nest [अंडी घालण्याचे डबे] per four hens.
- 5. Lighting Program [प्रकाश व्यवस्थापन]: Laying hens require 5% light [प्रकाश] starting from 20 weeks of age, which includes daylight. Generally, a 100-watt bulb at 70 feet height providing light [प्रकाश] at night improves feed intake. Start the lighting program [प्रकाश व्यवस्थापन] at a fixed time daily. Irregular timing can stress the hens and negatively impact their production [उत्पादन]. As egg laying begins, the lighting program [प्रकाश व्यवस्थापन] is gradually increased. The litter [कचरा] in the laying hen shed [निवारा] should be 5-6 inches thick.

Egg Production [अंडे उत्पादन]:

The average annual egg production [अंडे उत्पादन] should be 70 or more per hen. Poultry [कुक्कुट] farmers need to know how to identify laying hens and non-laying hens.

12.7 Laying Management [व्यवस्थापन] (24-68 week)

The laying management [व्यवस्थापन] starts right from onset of egg to culling. The breeder [संकरक] feeds, especially the hen feed is enriched with all micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] like trace minerals [सूक्ष्म खनिज] and vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] in order to obtain high rates of fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] and hatchability. Feed allowance in this stage should meet the demand for production [उत्पादन] of quality egg and proper body weight [शरीराचे वजन]. Delay in feed increment leads to poor production [उत्पादन], rapid drop, poor egg weight, more flucutation, more number of double yolk eggs [अंडी]. Excessive feeding [खाऊ घालणे] result in over body weight [शरीराचे वजन], poor egg quality, yolk peritonitis, proplaps and higher delpletion. Hence most recommended method of breeder [संकरक] feeding [खाऊ घालणे] is small and frequenent feeding [खाऊ घालणे]. It is suggested that once the bird start laying approx 5 % production [उत्पादन] then pre layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] feed should be replaced with layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] breeder [संकरक] feed. In broiler [मांसासाठी पालन केलेली कोंबडी] breeder [संकरक] feeding [खाऊ घालणे] thumb rule is feed should be consumed within four to six hours of feeding [खाऊ घालणे]. This feed clean up depends upon type of feed, quantity of feed, season, production [उत्पादन] status, health [आरोग्य] and age of the birds. Daily egg weight is important management [व्यवस्थापन] tool during breeder [संकरक] laying period. Egg weight is governed by body weight [शरीराचे वजन], feed, health [आरोग्य] and status and stress on the breeder [संकरक] bird. Any irregularity in the progress of egg weight is an early indicator of birds' production [उत्पादन] status. Under good management [व्यवस्थापन] practice daily 5 % egg weight should be taken as indicator of production [उत्पादन] performance.

Calcium [कॅल्शियम] for Layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी]

The major mineral required for egg shell quality is calcium [कॅल्शियम]. Thin egg shells are observedwhen calcium [कॅल्शियम], phosphorus [स्फुरद], zinc [झिंक] and vitamin D3 are not provided in diets at adequate levels. Layers need 3 3.5 gram [हरभरा] of calcium [कॅल्शियम] per day from first egg throughout the laying period. Therecommended strategy is to feed a constant, modest level of calcium [कॅल्शियम] in the feed and to usecalcium grit (e.g. limestone or oyster shell) to provide the additional requirement. After peakproduction the feed intake is gradually reduced and by increasing the amount of calcium [कॅल्शियम] grit, thetotal amount of calcium [कॅल्शियम] per day from feed and grit can be secured. The metabolic requirementfor calcium [कॅल्शियम] occurs mainly during the night when the egg shell is formed. Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] the additionalgrit in the afternoon can provide the bird with calcium [कॅल्शियम] during the night when it is needed most. Laying hens should have some portion of calcium [कॅल्शियम] available free-choice while calcium [कॅल्शियम] is beingadded to feed.

- 1. Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार]: For egg production [अंडे उत्पादन], newborn chicks need to be reared for eight weeks. During this period, they need to be given Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार] feed (0 to 8 weeks). During this time, there is a higher need for protein [प्रथिने] for growth [वाढ]. Therefore, the protein content [प्रथिन प्रमाण] in Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार] should be up to 20%. And energy should be at 2800 kcal per kg of feed. Chicks have very low ability to digest fibrous substances, but fibrous substances are needed for proper bowel movement and a feeling of fullness. Therefore, a fiber content of up to 7% in Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार] can be tolerated. Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार] feed is also called Starter feed [स्टार्टर्स फीड]. Feed Chick Mash [पिल्लांसाठी मिश्रित आहार] from the first day until the body weight [शरीराचे वजन] reaches 450 grams.
- 2. Grower Feed [ग्रोअर फीड]: Grower feed [ग्रोअर फीड] is required during the rearing of pullets [८–२० आठवड्यांचे मादी कोंबडे] from 8 to 20 weeks. This feed requires 16% protein [प्रथिने] and 2500 kcal/kg feed energy. During this period, changes or preparations required for egg laying are happening in the birds' bodies. Grower feed [ग्रोअर फीड] should contain 1% calcium [कॅल्शियम] and 0.4% available phosphorus [स्फुरद]. Start giving Grower feed [ग्रोअर फीड] once the birds weigh 450 grams.
- 3. Pre-Layer Feed [प्री-लेयर फीड]: From the 16th week onwards, the calcium [कॅल्शियम] requirement of the birds increases. Therefore, give pre-layer feed [प्री-लेयर फीड] from the 16th week. Increasing calcium [कॅल्शियम] in the feed prevents symptoms [लक्षणे] of calcium deficiency [कॅल्शियमचा अभाव]. Pre-layer feed [प्री-लेयर फीड] should contain 17% protein [प्रथिने], 2500 kcal/kg energy, and 2.5% calcium [कॅल्शियम].
- 4. Phase One Layer Feed [फेज वन लेयर फीड]: This feed should be started from the 18th week. At this time, birds will eat 100 to 110 grams of feed, and eggs [अंडी] will weigh 57 grams and be large in size, until then, give Phase One Layer feed [फेज वन लेयर फीड]. Generally, the egg size increases and reaches the 28th week. Phase One Layer feed [फेज वन लेयर फीड] should contain 16% protein [प्रथिने], 2400 kcal energy, and 3.5% calcium [कॅल्शियम].

- केळीच्या बांध्यावर झेंडू लागवड करता येते; त्याच वेळी पिवळे चिकट सापळे @२०–२५ प्रति एकर आणि प्रकाश सापळा १ प्रति एकर ठेवण्याचा उल्लेख आहे.

Almost all the diseases and pests of vegetable crops are found on tomatoes. For this, if the farmers implement integrated pest management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन], many pests can be controlled. *Loose housing [निवास व्यवस्था]*: Animals are usually kept in an open paddock in groups of 40 to 50 throughout the day and night except during milking [दूध काढणे] and for some other specific purposes like treatment [उपचार] and breeding [प्रजनन] when the animals are required to be tied. This system is ideal for areas of low rainfall such as Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Western Uttar Pradesh and parts of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. In other places this system can be used with modifications to protect animals from excessive rains. Such houses are cheap to construct, easy to expand at short notice, congenial to efficient management [व्यवस्थापन] and not prone to fire hazards. The loose system of housing [निवास व्यवस्था] is recommended for housing [निवास व्यवस्था] of cows in *Gaushala* in most parts of the country.

Close (tie) housing [निवास व्यवस्था]: Animals are tied in one place, and milking [दूध काढणे] and other routine operations carried out at this place. 4.1 Introduction

Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system, where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs.

Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. Irrigation [सिंचन] refers to the supplementary water provided to crops in addition to the rainfall they receive.

Water is intended for the crop [पीक], but because the medium is soil [माती], it must be given to the soil [माती]. Therefore, it is necessary to provide only the amount of water required according to the water holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] in each irrigation [सिंचन] cycle. The crop [पीक] does not experience stress until half of the available water in the soil [माती] is depleted, so there is no adverse effect on production [उत्पादन]. Therefore, in medium soils, 8 cm of water should be given in each irrigation [सिंचन] cycle. In deep black soils, 10 cm should be given in each cycle, while in shallow soils, 6 cm of water is necessary. In shallow soils, water exceeding the water holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] is drained away by gravitational pressure, while in deep black soils, there is a possibility of water shortage. Therefore, while determining the depth of watering for crops, it is necessary to consider the available water holding capacity [उपलब्ध पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] as well as the stage of the crop [पीक]. For this reason, the interval between watering cycles is longer in heavy soils, while it is shorter in shallow soils.

**Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

घरच्या साठवण खोलीत किंवा शेतात उंदीर नियंत्रणासाठी योग्य पद्धती पुढीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

**१. साठवण खोलीचे संरक्षण आणि स्वच्छता:**
- साठवण खोलीमध्ये उंदीरांच्या भुयारांची तपासणी करा आणि गरज असल्यास विषारी खाद्य (विषारी बेट) वापरा; अशा वेळी सुरक्षिततेची काळजी घ्या.
- साठवण खोलीमध्ये गोंधळ ठेवू नका, कारण त्यामुळे उंदीरांना लपण्याचे स्थान मिळते.
- धान्य साठवताना जमिनीवर लाकडी पाट किंवा पॉलिथिन पत्र्यावर टोपल्या ठेवा आणि टोपल्या खोलीच्या कडेला नाही तर मध्यभागीच ठेवा.
- दार, भिंत, खिडकी यांच्या भेगा/भेगांमध्ये कीटकनाशक फवारणी करून कीटक व उंदीर आलेल्या अवस्थेतही धान्य सुरक्षित ठेवता येते.

**२. उंदीर सापळे:**
- उंदीर सापळे (उंदीर ट्रॅप) वापरणे हा एक प्रभावी पर्याय आहे; असे सापळे उपलब्ध असतील तर ते वापरा.

**३. विषारी खाद्य (विषारी बेट) – शेतात उंदीर नियंत्रणासाठी:**
- शेतात उंदीर नियंत्रणासाठी झिंक फॉस्फाइड ८०% पावडरचा विषारी खाद्य बनवता येतो:  
  - मोदक बनवण्यासाठी ३८० ग्रॅम कुटलेले गहू/ज्वारी/मका + १० मिली खाद्यतेल (भुईमुग/अलसी) + १० ग्रॅम झिंक फॉस्फाइड ८०% पावडर चांगले मिसळा आणि १० ग्रॅमचे छोटे गोळे (हरभरा इतके) करा.
  - हे गोळे प्लास्टिक पिशव्यात भरून सील करा आणि प्रत्येक भुयारात एक पिशवी ठेवा.
  - सुमारे १० ग्रॅम झिंक फॉस्फाइड पावडर ४० भुयारांसाठी पुरेशी असते.
- **महत्त्वाची सूचना:** विषारी खाद्य केवळ आवश्यकतेनुसारच वापरा आणि मुले/जनावरे याला सहज पोहोचू शकणार नाहीत याची खात्री करा; हा विषारी पदार्थ असल्याने सुरक्षिततेची पूर्ण काळजी घ्या.

**४. साठवण खोलीचे रचनात्मक बदल:**
- साठवण खोलीचे प्लिंथ (आधारभाग) उंच ठेवा (किमान १.५–२.५ फूट), विशेषतः प्रवेशद्वाराजवळ; त्यामुळे उंदीर आत येणे कमी होते.

**५. सेंद्रिय/नैसर्गिक उपाय:**
- धान्य साठवताना कडूलिंबाच्या पानांचा वापर करता येतो; साठवण खोलीमध्ये हवेची हालचाल ठेवा.

**६. जास्त धोक्याची परिस्थिती:**
- जर साठवण खोलीमध्ये कीटक/उंदीर मोठ्या प्रमाणात नुकसान करत असतील, तर धान्य साठवण भागात अ‍ॅल्युमिनियम फॉस्फाइडची धुरीकरण पद्धत (२४ टॅबलेट्स/१००० घनफूट, २४ तास) वापरून सर्व अवस्था नष्ट करता येतात; ही पद्धत तज्ज्ञांच्या मार्गदर्शनाखालीच करा.

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शन डॉ. बाबासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; कृषी विज्ञान महाविद्यालय, राहाटा; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; एकात्मिक योजना – कृषी व्यापार (ISAM); पीएम सेवा केंद्र माहिती**

आपल्याकडे साठवण खोली आहे का, की शेतातच उंदीर समस्या जास्त आहे? त्यानुसार मी अधिक विशिष्ट उपाय सांगू शकतो.

Increased availability of fertilizers 6) Quality and higher yield [उत्पादन] is obtained **The following precautions should be taken when selecting fertilizers to be applied through a drip system:** 1. Fertilizers should be water-soluble as soon as possible. 2. The solubility of fertilizers should be high. 3. The precipitates in it should not be integrated in an insoluble form while or after dissolving in water. 4. Select fertilizers that do not have any effect on the components of the system. 5. Fertilizers should be safe for agricultural use. 6. Care should be taken to ensure that the fertilizer [खत] does not react chemically with the salts in the water. 7. If more than one fertilizer [खत] is to be applied at the same time, only those fertilizers should be applied together which do not have any chemical reaction with each other. Urea [यूरिया], diammonium phosphate and muriate of potash can be applied through the drip system, the latter two fertilizers have to be dissolved in water first. **Soluble Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** 1. Nitrogenous fertilizers 2. Phosphatic fertilizers 3. Potassic fertilizers **Nitrogenous Fertilizers:** Ammonium sulphate, ammonium chloride, calcium [कॅल्शियम] nitrate and urea [यूरिया] are water-soluble nitrogenous fertilizers available in the market. Crops take nitrogen [नत्र] in the form of nitrate. The nitrogen [नत्र] in ammonium sulphate and ammonium chloride is available in nitrate form in a short time. But these fertilizers increase the acidity [आम्लता] of the soil [माती]. Therefore, the pH decreases. As a result, the soils become infertile over time. Lime [चुना] has to be used to improve such soils. Therefore, use these fertilizers in small quantities. ``` ---- **Natural Farming Training Toolkit & Best Practices Guide** ``` 4.1 Introduction Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system, where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs. Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. Similarly, long-term NF trials in soybeanmaize and wheatmustard systems reported 1.31.8 times higher populations of beneficial soil microbes [मृदा सूक्ष्मजीव] and improved soil aggregation [मातीचे एकत्रीकरण] and moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे] under Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] practices.17 ``` ---- **NATIONAL PROGRAMME FOR ORGANIC PRODUCTION (NPOP 2024)** ``` 3.4.7 Culture practices Husbandry practices, including feeding [खाऊ घालणे], design of installations, stocking densities and water quality [पाण्याची गुणवत्ता] shall ensure that the developmental, physiological and behavioral needs of animals are fully met. 3.4.8 Pond [तलाव] preparation - i. For elimination of unwanted fishes, sun drying [उन्हात सुकवणे], netting or application of plant derivatives like tea [चहा] seed [बियाणे] cake (*Camellia sinensis*), mahua [महूआ] oil cake (*Bassia latifolia*), derris root powder (*Linchocarpus sp*.) and Neervalam (*Crotelaria tigilum*) are permitted. Use of any synthetic herbicides [तणनाशके] and pesticides are prohibited. - ii. Use of agricultural lime [चुना], dolomite [डोलोमाइट] or quick [नखाचा रक्तवाहिनी असलेला भाग] lime [चुना] is permitted for disinfection and acidity [आम्लता] corrections. - iii. Fertilizers with locally produced manures/ nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] (organic [सेंद्रिय] types farmyard manure [शेणखत], vermicompost [गांडूळखत]) for maintaining good Phyto and zooplankton and a stable pond [तलाव] environment should be followed. Biodegradable processing [प्रक्रिया] by-products of plant or animal origin may be used depending upon the feeding [खाऊ घालणे] behavior of the cultured organisms. The list of inputs for nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] should be followed as per Annex -3(13). Integrated farming system [एकात्मिक शेती प्रणाली] can be adopted for recycling of the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे]. - iv. Cow [गाय]-dung [शेण]/poultry manure [कोंबडी खत]/farmyard manure [शेणखत]/vermi-compost [कंपोस्ट] may be used as nutrient [पोषक घटक] source for carp farming [शेती करणे]. Intermittent application of cow [गाय]-dung [शेण]/poultry manure [कोंबडी खत] during culture operation should be in the fermented form. The manure [खत] to be used should be from organic [सेंद्रिय] sources. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` | **Tree Age (Years)** | **FYM**

Sulphur [गंधक] Sulphur [गंधक] is used for improvement of the chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन]. By reaction of water and oxygen from air Sulphur [गंधक] generates Sulphuric acids these sulfuric acid’s make a reactions with lime [चुना] in the soil [माती] and produce Calcium [कॅल्शियम] sulphate (Gypsum [जिप्सम]). Chalk + Sulphur [गंधक] + Acid = Gypsum [जिप्सम] + Water + Carbon di-oxide. With generated gypsum [जिप्सम]’s calcium [कॅल्शियम] creates a relations with soil [माती] sodium then Sodium Sulphate generated. Because Sodium Sulphate is soluble in water, gets leeched out with water and the level of sodium reduces in the soils, so the soil [माती] become more workable and physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] properties of the soil [माती] improved and good. In chalked alkaline soil [क्षारयुक्त जमीन] with soil testing [माती परीक्षण], 1/5th the content of gypsum [जिप्सम] can be mixed with FYM and used as soil amendment [मृदा सुधारणा]. **C. Soil Management [मृदा व्यवस्थापन]** 1. **Land Leveling [जमीन समतलीकरण]:** Leveling is essential for uneven or steeply sloping land. On unevenly levelled fields, water either doesn't reach the elevated areas or reaches in reduced quantities, while it accumulates in excess in low-lying areas. If there is an excessive slope, water applied through canals or wells runs off in the direction of the slope, and less water is available for irrigation [सिंचन]. In saline soils and soils with a high water table [पाण्याची पातळी], waterlogging [पाणी साचणे] should be avoided. Rainwater should also be directed in channels in the direction of the slope. Therefore, a slope of 0.05 to 0.25% is satisfactory for heavy soils, 0.20 to 0.40% for medium soils, and 0.25 to 0.35% for light [प्रकाश], sandy soils. 1. **Water Management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]:** To reduce the salinity [खारटपणा] of the soil [माती] and to prevent the water table [पाण्याची पातळी] from rising after the reclamation of saline soils [क्षारयुक्त मृदेची पुनर्बांधणी], excessive use of water should be minimized. Effective techniques such as drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] should be used. Drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] allows for the efficient use of brackish or saline groundwater. If the water quality [पाण्याची गुणवत्ता], salt [मीठ] level, and soluble salt [मीठ] content are up to 2000 milligrams/liter or 3.12 decisiemens/meter, the water can be used for drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. A 20% overlap of wetted area is necessary to maintain a constant moisture content [आर्द्रता] near the dripper outlet. The concentration of salts in the brackish water [खारट पाणी] is thereby reduced. Therefore, planting the crop [पीक] near the dripper is beneficial. ``` ---- **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth** ``` 4. **Deep Black Soils (Vertisols [काळी चिकण माती]):** These soils are grey to very black in color, have a depth of 50 to 100 cm, a pH of 7.5 to 8.5, and are calcareous. The levels of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], available nitrogen [नत्र], and available phosphorus [स्फुरद] are low to medium, while the level of available potash is high. These soils have high water holding capacity [पाणी धारण क्षमता] and available water content. It is beneficial to grow hybrid cotton [कापूस], pigeon pea [तूर] (late maturing), intercrops, and sequential crops in such soils. The use of broad bed furrow [रुंद बेड आणि सरी] method, contour vegetation, and tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] parallel to the bunds is appropriate to retain moisture. 5. **Brown Soils (Inceptisols):** These soils are medium to deep, eroded, acidic to neutral (pH 6.5 to 7.5). The available water content and water infiltration [पाणि झिरपण्याची क्षमता] capacity are medium, and the available nutrient [पोषक घटक] content is low. These soils are suitable for paddy and tree species [प्रजाती] such as teak [टिक], bamboo [बांबू], and eucalyptus [निलगिरी]. Contour planting of trees is appropriate for moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे]. Lime [चुना] should be used as per soil testing [माती परीक्षण] to increase the pH of these soils. ``` ---- **Biopesticides for Eco-Friendly Pest Management by ICAR** ``` - Fungal pathogens –Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum and Fusarium solani - - Crops: Tomato [टोमॅटो], capsicum [शिमला मिरची], okra [भेंडी], brinjal [वांगे], cabbage [पत्ता कोबी], cauliflower [फुल कोबी], chillies, carrot [गाजर], onion [कांदा], tuberose [रजनीगंध], gerbera [जरबेरा], crossandra [फायर क्रॅकर फ्लॉवर], gladioli, carnation [कार्नेशन], banana [केळी], papaya [पपई], pomegranate [डाळिंब], acid lime [लिंबू], citrus and grapes [द्राक्ष]; crops grown under protected conditions such as carnation [कार्नेशन], gerbera [जरबेरा], capsicum [शिमला मिरची], tomato [टोमॅटो], okra [भेंडी], muskmelon [खरबूज] and watermelon [टरबूज] - Method of application: Seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया] at 20 g or 20 mL/kg seed [बियाणे]; substrate treatment [उपचार] with 10 mL or 10g/kg of cocopeat [नारळ शेंड्यापासून तयार खत]; soil [माती] application at 5 kg or 5 L/ha after enrichment in 5 tons FYM before transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] or sowing [पेरणी] - Target agroecological zones [कृषी-पर्यावरण विभाग]/states: Karnataka - Validation: Experimental farms at ICAR-IIHR, Bengaluru, Karnataka for two years ARKA Plant Growth [वाढ] Booster ARKA Krishi All Rounder - Toxicological data required for CIB&RC registration [नोंदणी] already generated 28 ICAR TECHNOLOGIES: BIOPESTICIDES [जैव कीटकनाशक] 28\. मिर्चीचा रंग टिकवण्यासाठी साध्या उन्हात वाळवण्यापेक्षा **सावलीत वाळवणे** किंवा **सौर सुकवण यंत्राचा (सोलर ड्रायर) वापर** योग्य पद्धत आहे.

- मिर्ची, हळद अशा मसाल्याच्या पिकांसाठी काढणीनंतर ती **काढणीनंतर सावलीत वाळवणे** म्हणजेच सूर्यप्रकाश थेट पडू देऊ नये, हे रंग आणि गुणवत्ता टिकवण्यासाठी उपयुक्त असते.
- सोलर टनेल प्रकारचे सुकवण यंत्र (सोलर टनेल ड्रायर) वापरल्यास आत तापमान बाहेरील तापमानापेक्षा १० ते १५ अंश सेल्सियस जास्त राहते व गरम हवेचा प्रवाह होतो; त्यामुळे ओलावा लवकर कमी होतो. या यंत्रामध्ये **अतिनील (युव्ही) किरणे आत जात नाहीत**, त्यामुळे मिर्चीचा रंग, चव आणि गुणवत्ता मुख्यत्वे टिकून राहतो.
- सोलर कॅबिनेट ड्रायरमध्ये दिवसा सूर्यप्रकाशातून मिळणाऱ्या उष्णतेसह उष्णता साठवण प्रणाली असते; त्यामुळे सायंकाळी सूर्यप्रकाश कमी झाल्यानंतरही सुमारे २ तास गरम हवा मिळते आणि सामान्य पद्धतीपेक्षा कमी वेळेत मिर्ची कोरडी होते तसेच रंग व गुणवत्ता चांगली राहते.

**पायरीवार पद्धत:**  
1. मिर्ची काढणीनंतर थेट सूर्यप्रकाश टाळून सावलीत एकसारखी पसरवावी.  
2. शक्य असल्यास सोलर टनेल ड्रायर किंवा सोलर कॅबिनेट ड्रायरमध्ये मिर्ची वाळवावी.  
3. मिर्ची पूर्ण कोरडी झाल्यावर सुरक्षित ठिकाणी साठवावी.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**  

आपल्याकडे साधारण किती किलो मिर्ची दररोज वाळवायची आहे, म्हणजे मी सोलर टनेल ड्रायर की सोलर कॅबिनेट ड्रायर यापैकी कोणते यंत्र अधिक उपयोगी ठरेल ते सांगू शकेन?

3.9 Micro Irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

Micro-irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] encompasses systems like drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन], which deliver water directly to the plant root zone [मुळांचा भाग], minimizing evaporation and runoff [वाहून जाणारे पाणी]. In India, where agriculture [शेती] accounts for approximately 80% of water usage, adopting micro-irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] is crucial for enhancing water-use efficiency [पाणी वापर कार्यक्षमता] and ensuring sustainable crop production [शाश्वत पीक उत्पादन] (NITI Aayog, 2023).

**Recent Advances in Diagnosis and Control of Livestock Diseases**
```
Collection of blood [रक्त] smear

Blood [रक्त] smear means peripheral blood [परिधीय रक्त] smear. It is prepared from blood [रक्त] of ear vein; air dried and fixed on methanol for one minute. It can also be prepared from heart blood [रक्त]. (Peripheral blood [परिधीय रक्त] smear is preferred). Heart blood [रक्त] if not clotted can be drawn using sterile Pasteur pipette for microbiological examination.

Material (swabs or tissues or contents of lesion and tubular organ) for microbiological examination should be collected in aseptic conditions. The materials obtained can be sent without preservatives [संरक्षक (Preservatives)] i.e. on ice or in transport medium.

Collection of materials for microbiological examination

- 1. Collect materials from areas showing lesions and from sites where the organism concentrated. Example:- Vesicles in the mouth in FMD; Skin [त्वचा] lesions in pox [देवी]; Lymph nodes in theileriosis [थायलेरीओसिस]; strangles [स्ट्रॅंगल्स] or glanders [ग्लॅंडर्स].
- 2. Always collects material from fresh carcasses. In case of poultry [कुक्कुट], birds in advanced stage of ailment is sacrificed and materials are collected.
- 3. Use freshly sterilized equipments and containers.
- 4. Collected materials are sent in refrigerated condition (+ 4oC ) on ice.
- 5. Materials may also be sent using preservatives [संरक्षक (Preservatives)].

Bacteriology

Amies transport medium with charcoal or Stuart transport medium without charcoal.

Virology

Dispatch [नमुना पाठविणे] the material within 24 hours under refrigerated condition on ice.

If delay is expected store at -70oC (-20 to -25oC is also satisfactory but infectivity is reduced in certain cases.)

Dry [कोरडे] ice (solid CO2) can also used. Keep the specimens in tightly capped container to avoid deleterious effect of CO2.

Preservatives [संरक्षक (Preservatives)] like phosphate buffer saline (PBS), 50 % glycerol saline or virus transport medium may also be used.

Antibiotics are added to the different media. The quantity varies with specimens. Material with higher bacterial load e.g. intestine, intestinal contents, lung require highest concentration of antibiotics.

question: Tannashak fawarnisathi pathivar ghenyachya fawarni yantrache mojmap kase karave?
answer:
तणनाशक फवारणीसाठी फवारणी यंत्राचे मोजमाप (कॅलिब्रेशन) करणे म्हणजे फवारणी करण्यापूर्वी ठराविक क्षेत्रावर आणि ठराविक दाबाखाली किती द्रावण फवारले जाते हे तपासणे, म्हणजेच एकसारख्या दाबाखाली सर्वत्र समान प्रमाणात फवारणी होईल याची खात्री करणे.

मोजमाप कसे करावे:
1. स्वच्छ पाण्यात फक्त पाणी घेऊन फवारणी पंप चालू करा आणि शिफारशीप्रमाणे योग्य नॉझल वापरा.
2. शेतात १० मीटर x १० मीटर (१०० चौ.मी.) एवढे क्षेत्र निश्चित करा; त्याच क्षेत्रात वारंवार फवारणी करून घ्या.
3. फवारणी पूर्ण झाल्यानंतर पंपातील उरलेले द्रावण मोजा आणि नेमके किती द्रावण खर्च झाले ते काढा.
4. आता १०० चौ.मी. साठी लागणारे द्रावण मिळाले की, हे प्रमाण १००० चौ.मी. (१० डेसी.मी.) किंवा १०,००० चौ.मी. (१ हेक्टर) साठी सोडवून घ्या — म्हणजे जर १०० चौ.मी. साठी ४ लिटर लागले तर १००० चौ.मी. साठी ४० लिटर आणि १ हेक्टर साठी ४०० लिटर लागेल असा हिशोब करा.
5. दरवेळी फवारणी करताना दाब समान ठेवा, कारण दाब बदलला तर द्रावणाचा खर्चही बदलतो; त्यामुळे प्रत्येक वेळी दाब तपासा.
6. फवारणी सुरू असताना द्रावण काळाकाळात ढवळा, जेणेकरून तणनाशक तळाशी बसणार नाही.
7. पहिल्यांदाच तणनाशक वापरत असाल तर लहान क्षेत्रावर ट्रायल करा, आणि अनुभव नसेल तर तज्ज्ञांचा सल्ला घ्या.

मोजमापानंतर उपयोग:
- तुम्हाला नेमकी किती पाणी/द्रावण लागेल हे समजल्यावर, शिफारशीप्रमाणे तणनाशकाची मात्रा योग्य प्रमाणात मिसळता येते.
- रेषेत फवारणी (स्ट्रिप पद्धत) करत असाल तर प्रतिहेक्टर मात्रा फवारणी क्षेत्रानुसार ठरवा, म्हणजे तणनाशक वाचते.

सुरक्षितता:
- फवारणी करताना रबर हातमोजे वापरा, तंबाखू/धूम्रपान करू नका, आणि फवारणीनंतर साबणाने हात धुवा.
- शेजारच्या पिकांवर तणनाशकाचा फवार धूर जाऊ देऊ नका.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ (फवारणी यंत्राचे मोजमाप), एम.पी.के.व्ही. कृषी दर्शन (तणनाशक फवारणी काळजी)**

आपण कोणत्या पिकावर आणि कोणत्या तणनाशकाची फवारणी करायची आहे? त्यानुसार मी आपल्याला नेमके मोजमाप आणि मात्रा हिशोब सांगतो.

question: How to prevent Mastitis in high-yielding cows?
answer:
गायीमध्ये स्तनदाह (स्तनदाह) टाळण्यासाठी खालील व्यवस्थापन व स्वच्छता उपाय नियमित पाळा:

- दूध काढताना हातमोजे वापरा आणि प्रत्येक गायीसाठी वेगळे तौलिये/टिश्यू ठेवा, ज्याने थन कोरडे करा.
- दूध काढण्यापूर्वी आणि नंतर जर्मिसाइडिक थन डिप (थनांवर लावणारे द्रावण) वापरणे अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे; यामुळे थनावरील संसर्गजन्य कमी होतो.
- दूध काढण्याची साज/यंत्र नियमित स्वच्छ करून ठेवा आणि एका संक्रमित गायीचे दूध काढल्यानंतर ताबडतोब एकूण युनिट स्वच्छ करा.
- संक्रमित गायींना इतर गायींपासून वेगळे (अलग) ठेवा.
- गादी नेहमी कोरडी आणि स्वच्छ ठेवा; शक्य असल्यास रेत किंवा वाळूसारखी अजैविक गादी वापरणे चांगले, कारण त्यात जीवाणूंची वाढ कमी होते. गादी नियमित बदला/साफ करा.
- शेडमध्ये हवेची आदळ योग्य ठेवा, उष्णतेचा ताण कमी करा, आणि थनावर बर्फामुळे झालेली जखम/माशींच्या संपर्कापासून संरक्षण ठेवा.
- नवीन घेतलेली गायी झुंडमध्ये मिसळण्याआधी क्वारंटाइन (विलगीकरण) व आवश्यक तपासणी करूनच मिसळा.
- लसीकरणाबाबत – सामान्य दुग्धजन्य आजारांविरुद्ध लसीकरण करणे उपयुक्त; स्तनदाहाच्या विशिष्ट लसींबद्दल आपल्या स्थानिक पशुवैद्यकांचा सल्ला घ्या.
- दूध उत्पादन, थनांची अवस्था, आणि दूधातील बदल नियमित तपासा; लपलेला स्तनदाह (CMT परीक्षेने) शोधण्यासाठी पशुवैद्यकांकडून मदत घ्या.

Matching Terms for `mastitis`
